name: Colorblind Lens
description:
Draw a lens anywhere on the screen, like the screenshot tool's area selection. Everything seen through it is recolored live so that red-green colorblind eyes can tell reds from greens, while the rest of the screen stays as it is. Clicks pass through the lens.

Super+Shift+C draws a lens and closes it again; the Quick Settings tile does the same and holds the modes and a strength slider. The default Strong fix works for protan and deutan eyes alike, so you do not need to know your type.
